history.summary: Compact 678sqft 2BR at AMO Residence, the just-completed (2026) UOL development in Ang Mo Kio, listed $1.5M at $2,212 PSF — notably BELOW recent resale of $2,359–$2,618 PSF (avg ~$2,513). Backed by a deep 401-txn URA series and a strong 6.18% resale-only rate; the sub-median pricing on a quality, park-facing TE-line project is the most attractive entry in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: Web check confirms AMO resale transacts $2,359–$2,618 PSF (avg $2,513), so this $2,212 PSF listing is ~12% under market — a real discount, not a mispriced oversized unit (678sqft is efficient). Resale-only appreciation 6.18%/yr over 401 txns is highly reliable. UOL build quality, Bishan-AMK park views, 550m to Mayflower TE6, and a sub-$1.5M ticket = deep buyer pool. has_new_launch_bias flag is on but the 678sqft unit at $1.5M is squarely in the liquid sweet spot. Verify the listing isn't a problem stack given the discount.
red_flags: ~12% below resale median — confirm no defect/low-floor/poor-facing reason for the discount
TOP 2026 means initial rental/resale supply wave from the project's own MMR
catalysts: Priced ~12% under recent AMO resale transactions
6.18%/yr resale appreciation on a deep 401-txn series
Bishan-AMK Park frontage; UOL developer reputation
